title: [3.0-beta1] OrangeLink didn't work with Medtronic anymore
symptom: OrangeLink connected after phone restart, then AAPS tried to read the Medtronic history, but history reading started and interrupted immediately, with message 'Problem to connect pump...'.
cause: OrangeLink firmware version 3.2 has a bug that causes connection problems with Medtronic pumps; it is not an error in AAPS code.
fix: Downgrade OrangeLink firmware to version 2.5, which works fine with any AAPS version.
evidence_quote: Version 3.2 has a bug. I talked to developer and he is working on fixing it. If you downgrade to 2.5 it should work with any AAPS version.
